cd /tmp/dpctx && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='Dockerfile'
s=open(p).read()
# In builder stage, before the first uv sync, copy shared services into /app/03-shared-services
marker='WORKDIR /app\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \\\n  uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev'
assert marker in s, "marker not found"
repl='WORKDIR /app\nCOPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \\\n  uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev'
s=s.replace(marker,repl,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
EOF
sed -n '44,58p' Dockerfile
